press_resume: Press Resume to continue from checkpoint.
coaching_fatigue_significant: Your range of motion dropped {{decay}}% from the first half of your set to the second. This level of fatigue suggests reducing weight by 5-10% or adding 30 seconds of rest between sets.
coaching_fatigue_mild: Mild fatigue detected: {{decay}}% ROM decrease across the set. Form is still safe but watch for further degradation.
coaching_depth_none: None of your reps reached below parallel. For full muscle activation, aim to bring your hips below your knees at the bottom.
coaching_depth_partial: Only {{rate}}% of reps reached below parallel. Focus on consistent depth. Partial reps reduce quadriceps and glute activation.
coaching_depth_good: All reps reached below parallel. Excellent depth consistency.
coaching_knee_valgus: Knee valgus detected in {{rate}}% of reps. Your knees are collapsing inward at the bottom position. This increases ACL stress. Cue: "push knees out over toes." Consider glute activation warmup.
coaching_elbow_flare: Excessive elbow flare detected in {{rate}}% of reps. Wide elbows increase shoulder impingement risk. Aim for a 45-degree angle between your upper arm and torso.
coaching_trunk_lean: Excessive forward lean (avg {{avgLean}}°) detected. This shifts load from legs to lower back. Cue: "chest up, break at the hips and knees simultaneously."
coaching_lockout_incomplete: Only {{rate}}% of reps reached full lockout. Completing the top of the movement ensures full muscle contraction. Focus on extending fully at the top.
coaching_consistency_low: Your reps are inconsistent (consistency score: {{score}}/100). Rep {{rep}} deviated the most. A consistent rep pattern means each rep trains the same muscles through the same range.
coaching_consistency_good: Excellent rep consistency ({{score}}/100). Each rep follows the same controlled path. This is how you build reliable strength.
coaching_smoothness_jerky: Your movement appears jerky with abrupt speed changes. Smooth, controlled reps reduce injury risk and improve muscle time under tension. Slow down the eccentric (lowering) phase.
coaching_bar_path_drift: Significant lateral drift ({{drift}}%) detected in your bar path. A straighter path means more efficient force transfer. Check your grip width and ensure even loading.
coaching_balance_sway: Your center of mass shifts laterally during reps ({{sway}}% sway). This suggests one side is compensating. Focus on even weight distribution through both feet.
coach_no_history: No training history available. Start with a full-body session focusing on compound movements at moderate intensity.
insufficient_footage: Video quality insufficient for reliable scoring.
refuse_person_not_visible: Could not detect a person in enough of the video. Make sure your full body is visible.
refuse_no_movement: No repeated movement detected. Make sure you film a complete set.
confirm_count: We counted {{count}} reps. Is that right?
gate_reason_person_not_visible: Person detected in fewer than 60% of frames
gate_reason_frame_continuity_poor: Video had significant frame gaps or jumps
gate_reason_rep_count_too_low: Detected rep count is below expected minimum
gate_reason_rep_count_too_high: Detected rep count is above expected maximum
gate_reason_duration_too_short: Video is shorter than expected for this exercise
gate_reason_duration_too_long: Video is longer than expected for a single set
gate_reason_signal_amplitude_too_low: Joint angle range of motion is too small
filming_tips_title: HOW TO GET A GOOD ANALYSIS
filming_tip_light: Film in a well-lit area with natural or bright artificial light
filming_tip_angle: Place your phone at chest height, 2-3m away, with your full body visible
filming_tip_rom: Perform full range of motion on every rep
filming_tip_stable: Keep the camera steady — lean it against something or use a tripod
video_questionable: Some movement may be obscured. Results may vary.
video_unsuitable: Video may not be suitable for analysis. Try filming from the side with full body visible.
coach_no_workouts: No workouts recorded yet. Analyze a video first.
coach_notes_placeholder: Add your observations, recommendations, and next steps for the client...
video_too_long: Video is too long ({{duration}}s). Maximum is {{max}} seconds. Film a single set for best results.
analysis_timeout: Analysis timed out after {{seconds}} seconds. Try a shorter video with better lighting.
crash_recovery: Previous analysis of "{{file}}" was interrupted (browser ran out of memory). Try a shorter clip.
demo_description: See what your analysis looks like
test_banner_line2: Counts may be inaccurate, and form scores have not been validated.
